name: sync
title_zh: 备份、原子替换、复验三步走完的团队上下文同步器
tagline_zh: 团队上下文包更新不再靠手抄。它先备份现状，再整包替换，最后自动复验——出岔子能原样退回，你只管继续写代码。
tagline_en: Team context pack updates without manual copy-paste. Backs up, swaps atomically, re-verifies—rolls back clean if.
desc_en: Apply the team's published context Pack to this repository (backup, atomic replace, re-verify).
why_zh: 把「替换」做成事务：先留后路再动手，换完还自检一遍。比直接覆盖多一道保险，比手动 diff 少十次出错。
why_en: Treats replacement as a transaction: backup first, then swap, then verify. Safer than blind overwrite, faster than manual diffing.
limit_zh: 只认仓库里已发布的 context Pack 格式；不处理未发布的草稿目录。
limit_en: Only handles published context Pack layouts in-repo; ignores draft folders and won't validate cross-file references inside the pack.
title_en: Sync team context packs: backup, atomic swap, re-verify
